criterion.definition: AI-original-N reaches high fidelity if, on paired differences [metric(AI-original-N, clean) - metric(DGI-10000, clean)] pooled over seeds 2026-2029, the lower bound of the 95% bootstrap CI (2000 resamples over images, seeds kept together) is >= -0.02 for SSIM and >= -0.01 for Pearson r (non-inferiority to conventional 10,000-shot DGI)
criterion.minimum_N: smallest N meeting the criterion; reduction factor = 10000 / N
criterion.decided_on: validation first; frozen (checkpoint MD5s) before the single test evaluation
